home.heroTitle: Before the voices fade into silence.
home.heroSubtitle: A community-driven digital museum documenting, verifying, and preserving India’s vulnerable oral traditions, dialects, folk melodies, and indigenous craft knowledge.
home.recentRecordsDesc: Authentic voices, techniques, and rituals captured from the field.
home.whyMattersP1: India has {count}+ languages classified by UNESCO as vulnerable to critically endangered. Because these traditions live in speech, ceremony, and bodily craft rather than text, they disappear permanently when the last fluent elder or craftsperson passes away.
home.whyMattersP2: Existing linguistic surveys are slow, restricted mostly to the 22 scheduled languages, and built for academic linguists. Dharohar Setu equips ordinary families, students, and local cultural stewards with a simple, offline-first tool to capture this knowledge into a verifiable, permanent national archive.

untranslatable.title: Untranslatable Words & Micro-Traditions
untranslatable.subtitle: When an indigenous language recedes, entire ways of perceiving ecology, emotion, and ritual disappear. These terms have no single-word equivalent in English or Hindi.
